messages:
kevin: :rotating_light: PAGED — customers reporting model mismatch errors in eu-west for a subset of traffic. Responses are returning embeddings/outputs from an earlier model variant (v2) while policy says v3.3.

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by oncall: jordan. ETA 5m.

jordan: I can see error spike on routing logs. Region fallback floods showing requests routed to us-east but KV cache lookup key includes model:id that was compiled with old namespace. hypothesis: KV prefix includes region+model and when fallback kicked in, cache keys collided and returned v2 weights/kv entries.

maya: Customer-impact: multiple small customers (chat widgets) in EU seeing hallucinations & malformed structured responses. CS ticket 2345 indicates production errors started ~ 12:07 UTC.

support-bot: Logged affected customers: acme-inc, parcelly, quickforms. No PII. Volume ~ 2.3% of EU traffic.

kevin: Can we confirm rollback/backfill? Any recent routing policy change or deployment that touched kv namespaces?

jordan: There was a routing policy tweak 12:00 UTC to enable regional fallback to reduce latency during pod churn. The policy change included a new variant aliasing rule. The deploy introduced a subtle name change in model variant key generation: `model:v3.3` vs `model:v3_3` — our cache prefixing is not normalized, so older cache entries matched unexpectedly.

lisa: Repro steps in staging: trigger fallback with a simulated region outage, then check `redis --scan` keys. I can run a focused scan in prod with sample keys.

alex: Workaround plan: 1) disable regional fallback policy to force strict region-only routing 2) drain EU fallback pool 3) invalidate affected KV prefixes 4) roll forward a normalization repair if needed.

jordan: I'll flip the routing toggle to strict now. Command:
```
redwoodctl routing set-policy --region eu-west --policy strict-region
```

incident-bot: Routing policy change recorded by deploy-bot at 12:16 UTC by jordan.

maya: While routing is strict, some traffic will go to overloaded region pods — watch latency. Set SLO alert to 400ms temporarily.

kevin: Lisa, start cache invalidation job for keys matching `*model:v2*` and `*v3_3*` pattern in eu-west namespace. Use dry-run first.

lisa: Dry-run results: ~8.3k keys matched. Majority are prefix cached KV entries for attention caches. Deleting them will increase token cost but needed.

lisa: Running delete now (progress dots):
```
# careful: prod operation
redis-cli -h eu-redis-prod --scan --pattern 'eu-west:*model:*' | xargs -L 100 redis-cli -h eu-redis-prod del
```

alex: Parallel mitigation: create temporary alias mapping so requests that still hit mismatched cache are re-resolved to correct variant. Patch to routing service pushed as hotfix.

jordan: Hotfix applied. Added normalizer: `normalize_model_key(var) -> var.replace('_','.')` which should unify `v3_3` and `v3.3` lookups.

support-bot: CS notified affected customers with mitigation steps at 12:23 UTC.

maya: Monitoring: errors trending down, mismatch cases falling from 2.3% to 0.1% in 6 minutes. Latency slightly up for EU by ~30ms.

kevin: Good. Keep routing strict until we validate for 1 hour. Action items: 1) postmortem owner: jordan 2) engineering follow-up: normalize key generation in deployment tooling (alex) 3) run job to rebuild caches with canonicalized keys (lisa).

jordan: Handing off to next oncall (alex) at 13:00 UTC. I'll update PagerDuty. If anyone sees any spike, reopen the page.

pagerduty-bot: On-call handover: jordan -> alex at 13:00 UTC.

kevin: Customer impact summary for incident report: brief outage of smart routing fallback for eu-west caused ~2.3% of EU requests to serve stale variant entries for ~16 minutes. Affected customers: acme-inc, parcelly, quickforms. Mitigations: routing toggle, cache invalidation, key normalization hotfix. Postmortem scheduled.

support-bot: CS follow-up: templated apology + troubleshooting steps sent. Customers requesting postmortem.

jordan: Adding quick log snippets for postmortem:
```
# example mismatch log
2026-03-15T12:07:21Z route=eu-west fallback=true requested_variant=v3.3 served_variant=v2 cache_key=eu-west:model:v3_3:prefix123
```

lisa: I'll stage a non-prod test to simulate fallback churn every hour to catch normalization issues.

alex: Thanks all. Locking thread now. Reopen for any regressions. :white_check_mark:
